prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Generate exactly ONE isolated reusable building sprite for tianshu default building-map, Ming dynasty northern Chinese prefectural city (Beijing/Datong/Xian regional vocabulary), anonymous original period-inspired design, not a measured heritage reconstruction. Orthographic 2:1 dimetric ground projection, camera yaw45 elevation30, east axis down-right slope +0.5 and north up-right slope -0.5; parallel ground edges, vertical posts, no perspective convergence. South entrance on screen lower-left edge. Complete building on thin rectangular ground-contact footprint with readable left, front, right corners, footprint axis ratio as specified, no thick pedestal, no soil island. Neutral soft light from SCREEN UPPER LEFT, short soft contact shadow only toward lower-right. TRUE transparent RGBA background and generous blank alpha0 margins all four sides; no skyline, no surrounding scenery. No people, writing, Chinese pseudo-glyphs, text, plaques, signs, banners, watermark, grid, modern fittings, plastic render, cartoon, ink wash, oversaturation, dense lanterns, white halo or baked checkerboard. A compact symmetrical official yamen courtyard module on clear north-south axis. Gate and modest screen wall, sober grey-brick side walls, main five-bay single-story hall with grey tile hip-and-gable roof, muted dark red structural timber and tiny subdued blue-green beam detail, grey-tile hard-gabled side rooms. No yellow imperial tiles. Courtyard flat pavers with clear passage.
